name: code-reviewer
description: Reviews a code diff you paste (unified diff, e.g. from git diff) and gives review comments by severity (critical, required, optional, nit), each tied to a changed line, with suggested replacements. It reviews correctness, readability, architecture, surface-level security, performance and your team's standards (paste them after "standards:"), and checks the change against a spec or issue text you paste after "spec:". The verdict (request changes, comment, or no blocking comments), size class and tests note are computed in code. It reads only what you paste: no repository, no PR link, and it posts nothing. Not for writing new code, deep security audits, what could break outside the diff, PR descriptions or general programming questions.

skills.name: Review a diff
skills.description: Review comments by severity on a pasted diff, each tied to an added line with an optional suggested replacement; optional spec check and team standards. Read-only: nothing is posted.
examples: Review against this spec: refunds must be partial-capable, logged, idempotent + <diff>
Review with our standards: no bare except, type hints required + <diff>
